findings.description: Method `bump` writes to `env.storage()` but does not call `env.require_auth()`. Callers may mutate contract state without proving they are authorized.
findings.suggestion: Add `env.require_auth();` as the first statement in the function body.

findings.description: Method `bump` writes to storage but does not emit an event. Consider using `env.events().publish(…)` to allow off-chain indexers to track contract activity.
findings.suggestion: Add `env.events().publish((symbol_short!("bump"), …), &payload)` after the storage write so off-chain indexers can track this state change.
